$Comment: The plain Greater Essence of Life roll at both Disenchanting Tables, kept in a table of its own so two Enchanting talents can shut it through this table's Requires: Purist (the Essence Trade) gives Greater Essence up for its second wage, and Rite of Purity (the Rite) rolls its own, four times as likely, in Mmo_Disenchant_Talents. Each Not names only that talent's holder, so everyone else, and a server with Enchanting switched off or no Enchanting track at all, rolls it as always.
